label: Possibly, some CONCRETE_AND_ABSTRACT_6 individual exists necessarily
paraphrase: Some history accessible from the selected world contains one concrete individual that exists there and in every world accessible from there (BruteFoundationBoundary.NecessaryConcreteAt at that history; the grounding relation is part of the profile but not used by the condition). Under actual reflexivity and a Euclidean frame this gives a necessary concrete individual at the selected world itself. 'Concrete' is the supplied Concrete parameter; nothing is said about which individual it is.
